in_marathi.name: Gajadhar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gajadhar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Gajadhar is derived from the Sanskrit words 'gaja' meaning elephant and 'dhar' meaning one who sustains or protects. The name is given to a child who is believed to possess the strength and power of an elephant.
